{{Top|leg}}
The '''G-12 Barracks''' was a [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] in zone [[Sector N-Seven|N7]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|original Death Star]].

It contained the quarters of several of the non-commissioned officers assigned to the Death Star, including [[Nova Stihl]].
